image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (polyplacophore) clinging to a rocky substrate. The organism has an elongated oval shape with a reddish-brown leathery girdle surrounding eight distinct, overlapping calcareous plates on its dorsal surface. The plates are textured with ridges and appear greyish-tan against the darker girdle. The background consists of rough, encrusted rock surfaces.
